title: Matrix LR down-sweep (MATRIX_LR 0.04 -> 0.03)
description: Decreased MATRIX_LR (Muon LR) from 0.04 to 0.03, 25% lower, all else unchanged from DEPTH=10 baseline.
reflection: val_bpb 1.006195, worse than the 1.002279 baseline (and worse than round 2's 0.05 result too, which was ~1.0058-1.0060). This confirms MATRIX_LR=0.04 sits at or very near a local optimum on this axis in both directions -- neither raising nor lowering it helps. Further MATRIX_LR sweeps should stop; future rounds should try a genuinely unexplored axis (e.g. WINDOW_PATTERN, HEAD_DIM, TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE, or WEIGHT_DECAY) rather than more single-scalar LR perturbations near baseline.
